purpose: Resolve documentary methods/schema and data-use terms for the already identified dielectric_constant lead only; Li remains primary and no benchmark is selected or admitted.

requests.purpose: Identify the exact DOI-matching primary article and legitimate PMC full-text identifier from metadata; no broad search.

requests.requires: Exactly one DOI-matching metadata result with PMCID matching PMC followed by digits and open-access full-text availability.
requests.purpose: Primary article container for a numeric-redacted Methods/Data Records prose projection; never disclose results, target tables, captions or supplementary files.

requests.requires: A unique unambiguous Figshare data citation DOI/record ID in the acquired primary article; no guessed association from a similar title.
requests.purpose: Read exact cited dataset/collection identity, version, license and file metadata only; never follow file download URLs.

requests.requires: The third request identified an exact collection, declares at most ten constituent articles and does not itself expose their metadata. No request if route is an article, exceeds cap or identity is ambiguous.
requests.purpose: Bounded constituent metadata/identifiers only, not download/file contents. No further followup after this request.

transport.access_failure: Preserve once and stop the affected source route; no mirror, alternate host or bypass.

reader.json: Strict UTF-8 JSON within cap; metadata only. Only selected identity/license/URL/count fields are printed.
reader.xml: Bounded XML parsed without external entities, DTD loading or network resolution. The researcher-facing prose allowlist is sections whose ancestor title is Methods or Data Records. All table-wrap, table, fig, graphic, media, supplementary-material and formula subtrees are suppressed. All Unicode decimal/digit runs in remaining prose are replaced before display. Researcher may inspect section titles, exact source locators and data-citation DOI identifiers, but no unredacted full body, table, result, figure/caption or numeric target literal. Unknown XML layout or article identity blocks projection rather than falling back.

exposure.machine: If requested, the complete primary XML container is acquired and parsed and can contain measurements/results/tables, even though those subtrees are not researcher-facing. Whole article machine exposure is explicit; no globally untouched-source claim. JSON metadata may include abstracts or aggregate descriptions.
exposure.researcher: Selected DOI identity, methods/data-record prose after numeric redaction, section locators, citation identifiers and repository metadata. Prose itself may reveal qualitative scientific findings or cohort construction; retain any such exposure. No claim that redaction makes the document epistemically empty.
exposure.public: Own paraphrase, necessary method/schema field labels, primary citations, exact request/body hashes and exposure limits. Raw XML/metadata bodies and broad prose excerpts remain ignored and excluded from publication.

forbidden: Raw observation dataset, label table, workbook, notebook, figure or supplementary data acquisition
Researcher display of full target tables or numeric outcome literals
Cited-paper fetch chains, paywall workarounds, alternative-source retries
Fitting, feature/endpoint/threshold selection, allocation, calibration or admission
Inferring data-file rights from article/software licensing
Inferring archive equivalence, pairing, missingness, independence or model-training freshness from a metadata match
decision: Report only supported method/unit/definition/schema/rights statements and unresolved premises. At most two repository metadata calls; if that cannot resolve identity or rights, stop with the gap. No automatic later data acquisition.
